CHN.scope: China consolidated central and local budget expenditure, 1990 actual, 308.4bn yuan, NBS Statistical Yearbook; 4.783 yuan per US$.

exps.name: Capital construction
exps.note: Budget-financed capital construction investment: energy, transport, raw materials and key projects.

exps.name: Circulating capital for enterprises
exps.note: Additional working capital appropriations for state enterprises.

exps.name: Science and technology innovation funds
exps.note: Funds for technological innovation, new product trials and science and technology development.

exps.name: Geological prospecting
exps.note: Geological survey and mineral exploration expenses.

exps.name: Industry, transport and commerce operating expenses
exps.note: Operating expenses of industrial, transport and commercial departments.

exps.name: Support for agriculture
exps.note: Support for rural production and agricultural departments: irrigation, flood control, extension, disaster relief and agricultural operating expenses.

exps.name: Culture, education, science and health
exps.note: Education, science, culture, health and sports operating expenses of government at all levels.

exps.name: Pensions and social relief
exps.note: Pensions for the disabled and martyrs' families, and social relief funds.

exps.name: National defense
exps.note: Official budgeted defense spending of the People's Liberation Army; actual military spending was believed to be higher, partly funded off-budget.

exps.name: Government administration
exps.note: Public security, procuratorate, courts, foreign affairs and general administration.

exps.name: Price subsidies
exps.note: Consumer price subsidies, mostly grain, edible oil, cotton, meat and other staples sold below cost.

exps.name: Other expenditures
exps.note: Residual to the official 1990 total expenditure of 308.359bn yuan: urban maintenance and construction, debt service, local operating expenses and other items the yearbook does not itemise.
